notes: 'Is it not so' has two supplied words separated by the negative's own 'not', so they are two added units rather than one run under rule 2; the fronted copula is the interrogative particle's under rules 17 and 20. The competing reading gives 'not so' whole to לוֹא.
The waw of וַיֹּאמֶר takes the postposed 'moreover' under rules 14 and 51; the unit is discontinuous rather than broken, and distance from the waw is not evidence against it.
